description.en: The Faroe Islands , also known as the Faroes, are an archipelago in the North Atlantic Ocean and a rigsdel of the Kingdom of Denmark. Located between Iceland, Norway, and the Hebrides and Shetland isles of Scotland, the islands have a population of 55,466 as of July 2026 and a land area of 1,393 km2 .
description.zh-CN: 法羅群島是丹麥王國的一个自治領，地理位置介乎挪威海和北大西洋中間，處於挪威到冰島之間距離一半的位置。 法羅群島陸地面積1,399平方公里，由18个火山岛组成。
description.zh-TW: 法羅羣島是丹麥王國的一個自治領，地理位置介乎挪威海和北大西洋中間，處於挪威到冰島之間距離一半的位置。 法羅羣島陸地面積1,399平方公里，由18個火山島組成。

photo.alt: A Mercedes-Benz truck Atego in Vágur, Faroe Islands. The dog is the driver ;-) The sentence Cadbury - rætta navnið á sjókulátu means in Faroese language: Cadbury - the right name for chocolate. The truck driver's dog is of course only protecting the parked truck, though it looks like he is driving it. :-)
